lines: OFFICE OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS
ADOPTING SCHEDULE A, THE RATE CARD FOR SHARING THE BUYER PREMIUM AND QUALITY BONUS FOR SEASON 2026-A

WHEREAS, the General Assembly, at its meeting of 28 February 2026, approved that the premium and the quality bonus paid by the buyer, Lantern Bay Chocolate Co., for dried fermented cacao delivered in Season 2026-A (1 April to 31 August 2026) be shared among the members who deliver;
WHEREAS, the General Assembly directed the Board of Directors to fix the rules of sharing, and the only deductions that may be made, before the first delivery of the season;

NOW, THEREFORE, on motion duly seconded, the Board RESOLVED, as it hereby RESOLVES, to adopt Schedule A, attached as page 2, as the rate card for Season 2026-A, binding on the Treasurer for every payout of the season.
RATIFIED this 14th day of March 2026 at Calinan, Davao City.

ADOPTING SCHEDULE A, THE RATE CARD FOR SHARING THE BUYER PREMIUM AND QUALITY BONUS FOR SEASON 2026-A
WHEREAS, the General Assembly, at its meeting of 28 February 2026, approved that the premium and the quality bonus paid by the buyer, Lantern Bay Chocolate Co., for dried fermented cacao delivered in Season 2026-A (1 April to 31 August 2026) be shared among the members who deliver;
WHEREAS, the General Assembly directed the Board of Directors to fix the rules of sharing, and the only deductions that may be made, before the first delivery of the season;
NOW, THEREFORE, on motion duly seconded, the Board RESOLVED, as it hereby RESOLVES, to adopt Schedule A, attached as page 2, as the rate card for Season 2026-A, binding on the Treasurer for every payout of the season.
RATIFIED this 14th day of March 2026 at Calinan, Davao City.

lines: RATE CARD, SEASON 2026-A (1 April to 31 August 2026)
R0  Premium ug bonus (Premium and quality bonus)

The premium paid by the buyer shall be shared among members in proportion to verified kilos delivered. No deduction of any kind shall be made from the premium. The quality bonus shall be shared in proportion to verified Grade 1 kilos.
Capital build-up (CBU): 5% of the member's quality bonus, until the member's paid-up CBU reaches ₱5,000.
Hauling: ₱1.50 per kilo of net weight for deliveries collected at a purok pickup point.
Loan repayment: only with a signed Authority to Deduct on file, and not more than 50% of the member's quality bonus.
Cash advance: only against a numbered voucher, and not more than 30% of the member's quality bonus.
The Chairperson shall co-sign any payout batch over US$300, any member line over US$150, and any override of a hold.
Verified kilos must agree with kilos shipped within ±2.0%. A member's season kilos may not exceed 1.6 kg per registered tree. Any reading below 0.85 confidence shall be confirmed by a person.
No deduction other than those in this Schedule shall be applied to any member payout. This Schedule shall not be amended during Season 2026-A.

BOARD RESOLUTION NO. 2026-04 · SCHEDULE A
RATE CARD, SEASON 2026-A (1 April to 31 August 2026)
R0  Premium ug bonus (Premium and quality bonus)
The premium paid by the buyer shall be shared among members in proportion to verified kilos delivered. No deduction of any kind shall be made from the premium. The quality bonus shall be shared in proportion to verified Grade 1 kilos.
R1  CBU (Capital build-up)
Capital build-up (CBU): 5% of the member's quality bonus, until the member's paid-up CBU reaches ₱5,000.
R2  Hakot (Hauling)
Hauling: ₱1.50 per kilo of net weight for deliveries collected at a purok pickup point.
R3  Utang (Loan)
Loan repayment: only with a signed Authority to Deduct on file, and not more than 50% of the member's quality bonus.
R4  Bale (Cash advance)
Cash advance: only against a numbered voucher, and not more than 30% of the member's quality bonus.
R5  Pirma sa Chairperson (Co-signature)
The Chairperson shall co-sign any payout batch over US$300, any member line over US$150, and any override of a hold.
R6  Mga utlanan (Limits)
Verified kilos must agree with kilos shipped within ±2.0%. A member's season kilos may not exceed 1.6 kg per registered tree. Any reading below 0.85 confidence shall be confirmed by a person.
Sirado nga lista (Closed list)
No deduction other than those in this Schedule shall be applied to any member payout. This Schedule shall not be amended during Season 2026-A.
CERTIFIED CORRECT:
MA. THERESA L. GUMAPAC
Secretary
ATTESTED:
